tex_content.html:
Lemma
1. ch5:5.10\group chapter-5 Source: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0096

↗ gt.def5.9.adjoint-hilbert ↗ gt.thm5.6 For a bounded operator $T$ on a Hilbert space, $\overline{\operatorname {ran}T}=(\ker T^*)^\perp $.
Proof

Source: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0096

\sketch The adjoint identity gives $\operatorname {ran}T\subset (\ker T^*)^\perp $. Decompose an arbitrary vector by the projection theorem relative to $\overline{\operatorname {ran}T}$; its orthogonal component belongs to $\ker T^*$, which proves the reverse inclusion after taking orthogonal complements.

□

Theorem
[Hilbert-space Fredholm alternative]
